# Golden Pillar Services

> Fitout, construction, cleaning, joinery, and signage contractor based in Al Amerat, Muscat, Sultanate of Oman. CR 1534792, established 05/02/2024, registered SME with Riyada.

Golden Pillar Services Establishment LLC (الركيزة الذهبية للخدمات) is a licensed contractor serving Muscat and greater Oman. Core services: interior fitout & construction, commercial/residential cleaning, custom joinery (built in-house workshop), and signage design/fabrication/installation.

Contact: +968 7774 0100 (Salman Shoukat) or +968 9377 7171 (Abdullah Ahmed), also reachable on WhatsApp. Email info@goldenpillar.om. Office: Building 7481, Office 8, Beside Sultan Center, Al Amerat, Muscat. Hours: Sun–Thu, 8:00 AM–6:00 PM.

Site available in English (/en/) and Arabic (/ar/).

## Services

- [Fitout & Construction](https://goldenpillar.om/en/services/fitout-construction/): Commercial and residential fitout and construction work in Muscat.
- [Cleaning Services](https://goldenpillar.om/en/services/cleaning-services/): Trained, supervised cleaning crews, including post-construction cleanup.
- [Joinery](https://goldenpillar.om/en/services/joinery/): Custom joinery manufactured in our own workshop, site-measured.
- [Signage](https://goldenpillar.om/en/services/signage/): Outdoor-rated signage, design through installation, in-house support.
